name: site-selection-addendum
description: Drafts a Site Selection Addendum for franchise real estate transactions, establishing objective site criteria, sequential approval processes, conditions precedent, and economic adjustments that modify an existing agreement. Covers geographic parameters, physical specifications, zoning, environmental due diligence, title examination, financing contingencies, and dispute resolution. Use when supplementing franchise agreements with site approval workflows, drafting site selection riders, or adding location criteria to commercial leases.
